concept: Maintaining quality standards under real deadline and budget pressure
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic professional scenario where time or budget pressure creates a genuine temptation to cut corners
exercise.reflection_prompt: Where's the real line between a reasonable tradeoff and a corner that shouldn't be cut?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies which specific corners are acceptable to cut here and which aren't, and why

assessment.success_marker: adult draws a specific, reasoned line rather than either 'never compromise' or 'whatever gets it done'
